    • printToFile

      public static boolean printToFile(Path file, String content, boolean overwriteIfExists)
      Prints a given String to a given File, overwrites the current content of the file, creates a new if it does not exist Prints the stacktrace to the error if it fails
      Parameters:
      file - the Path to the file to be written to
      content - the content to be written in the file
      should - the file be overwritten if it already exists
      Returns:
      true if the writing succeeded, false if it failed
